user.title: Matkoll
user.description: Adds Matkoll to the sidebar: a food diary for everyone with a Home Assistant login, a shared meal plan, recipes with calories per gram, barcode scanning in the Home Assistant app, and Mealie sync. Settings live in the Matkoll panel under You.

log_food.name: Log food
log_food.description: Adds food to a person's Matkoll diary, found by name or barcode.

food.name: Food
food.description: Name of a food or recipe in Matkoll, or a barcode.

meal.name: Meal
meal.description: Which meal. Defaults to the current time of day.

person.name: Person
person.description: Whose diary. Defaults to the user running the action.

sync_mealie.name: Sync with Mealie
sync_mealie.description: Syncs the meal plan with Mealie now (it also syncs every 15 minutes by itself).
